cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: No evidence of CRLF sequences being used as special elements for line/record separation. The watchdog parameter is passed to a shell command, not used in contexts where CRLF would have special meaning (HTTP headers, log files, etc.).

connection.evidence: User-controlled params[:watchdog] is directly passed to add_node function, which based on context summary will be interpolated into shell command execution.

diff_causality.evidence: The added parameter introduces a new user-controlled input vector to the add_node function call.

security_control.required_control: CRLF sequence validation for contexts where CRLF has special meaning
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-93 requires validation when CRLF sequences are used as special delimiters in output contexts
existing_controls_checked: Authentication (Permissions::FULL required) prevents unauthorized access but doesn't address CRLF injection
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No evidence that CRLF sequences are relevant to this shell command execution context or that CRLF validation is required

concrete_impact.evidence: No demonstrated impact specific to CRLF injection. The parameter is used in shell command execution where command injection (CWE-78) would be the relevant concern, not CRLF injection.

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the watchdog parameter would not be passed to the add_node function, eliminating this input vector entirely.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled params[:watchdog] parameter is passed to add_node function
contradicting_evidence: No evidence of CRLF sequences being used as special elements in this context
The parameter flows to shell command execution, not CRLF-sensitive contexts
unresolved_facts: How the watchdog parameter is used within add_node function
Whether the watchdog value is interpolated into shell commands or used as a discrete parameter
What format/validation is expected for watchdog values
